name: personal-toolbox
description: A frontend/backend separated personal toolbox monorepo.

scripts.dev: corepack pnpm run contracts:build && corepack pnpm --parallel --filter @personal-toolbox/web --filter @personal-toolbox/api dev
scripts.dev:web: corepack pnpm run contracts:build && corepack pnpm --filter @personal-toolbox/web dev
scripts.dev:api: corepack pnpm run contracts:build && corepack pnpm --filter @personal-toolbox/api dev
scripts.test: corepack pnpm run contracts:build && corepack pnpm -r --if-present test
scripts.test:documents:live: corepack pnpm run contracts:build && corepack pnpm --filter @personal-toolbox/api test:documents:live
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm run contracts:build && corepack pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
